_comment: Netlists of the Logik-Werkstatt that the page (logic_circuit.js, test/static/logic_circuit.test.cjs) and the server (circuit_check.rb, circuit_check_test.rb) must read and run the same way: each with its truth table (the outputs of every row, the first input the highest bit, every row from a circuit whose gates are all 0), or the first message of a netlist that cannot be read.

tables.name: XOR from four NAND
tables.text:
in a
in b
nand x a b
nand l a x
nand r x b
nand g l r
out y g

tables.name: a gate with three inputs, positions and comments
tables.text:
# majority
in a @48,40; in b @48,104; in c @48,168
and g1 a b @120,40
and g2 a c
and g3 b c
or m g1 g2 g3 @240,80
out y m @360,96

tables.name: a full adder of two blocks
tables.text:
block HA
  in a
  in b
  xor x a b
  and k a b
  out s x
  out c k
end
in a
in b
in c_in
HA h1 a b
HA h2 h1.s c_in
or o h1.c h2.c
out s h2.s
out c_out o

tables.name: blocks inside blocks, an output straight from an input
tables.text:
block WIRE
  in i
  out o i
end
block NOTW
  in i
  WIRE w i
  not n w.o
  out o n
end
in a
NOTW t a
WIRE u a
out y t.o
out z u.o

tables.name: an input without a wire reads 0
tables.text:
in a
or g a -
out y g

tables.name: a gate that turns itself round never comes to rest
tables.text:
in a
not n n
out y n

sequences.name: a D latch of NOR, from all gates at 0
sequences.text: in d; in takt; not nd d; and r nd takt; and s d takt; nor m r mn; nor mn m s; out q m
